summary: Quince Therapeutics acquired Orphai Therapeutics in a stock-for-stock merger via two-step forward triangular merger, closed May 17, 2026 (effective May 18). Quince issued 3,258,517 shares of common stock and ~67,101 shares of Series C convertible preferred (each convertible into 1,000 common shares) to Orphai's stockholders. Exact price per share or premium not disclosed; transaction intended as tax-free reorganization. No mention of board recommendation or advisors. Series C preferred conversion subject to conditions. Quince's existing shares remain outstanding; no cash consideration. What to watch: potential dilution from conversion; regulatory closing conditions; post-merger combined entity strategy.
